==Ingredients==
*1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] uncooked [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 large scoop (⅛ tsp) [[Cookbook:Saffron|saffron]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] (or artificial [[Cookbook:Sweeteners|sweetener]]) 
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]] (or [[Cookbook:Currant|currants]]) 
*¼–½ cup slivered [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]], toasted if desired

==Procedure==

# Wash rice, and transfer to a pot.
# Add enough water to cover rice with water equal to the depth of the rice.
# Add salt, saffron, sugar, and raisins.
# Cook over high heat until water disappears and steam is rising from holes in the surface of the rice.
# Reduce heat to warm. Add almonds.
# Cover tightly and let stand for 20 minutes.
